questions.a: TRACES ARE INSTANCE-SPACE, VERDICTS ARE COMMONS. A trace is runtime state (~/.cairn — never in git); a labeled training pair is knowledge (losing it loses what Akien taught — CairnCommons/learning/). The line is the roots table's own test.

THE INSPECTOR IS A STEP, NOT A RESIDENT. It fires as the skill's exit act (the event is the work finishing), reaches Hex through inference_domain when LLM-depth is needed, and dies with the step. Nothing stands running (NO DAEMONS).
THE DIAL IS A VIEW. Counters are projected from the trace on read — compile-if-stale, the read is the event — so the dial can never disagree with the record it summarizes.
